mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( host_user_id, name, description, place_type, area_size, capacity, allows_small_dog, allows_medium_dog, allows_large_dog, provides_home_camera, provides_realtime_photo, provides_yard, provides_walk, other_options, hourly_price, nightly_price, status ) VALUES ( #{hostUserId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{placeType}, #{areaSize}, #{capacity}, #{allowsSmallDog}, #{allowsMediumDog}, #{allowsLargeDog}, #{providesHomeCamera}, #{providesRealtimePhoto}, #{providesYard}, #{providesWalk}, #{otherOptions}, #{hourlyPrice}, #{nightlyPrice}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, place_status AS status FROM place WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
